instructions: Run T5 (Select) per prompts/t5_select.md, using the freshly written state/assessments/scores.json (last_assessed_cycle: 4, all 6 issues scored this cycle for the first time). Candidate set = all issues with score < 5 (currently all 6 qualify). Current scores from cycle 4: task-dependent-reliability-framing=1, ioc-extraction-reliability=2, consistency-calibration-as-failure-mode=2, institutional-incident-real-world-impact=2, ttp-attack-mapping-reliability=3, attribution-confident-wrong-gap=3. Apply the selection policy mechanically: (1) base priority = score, lower wins -- task-dependent-reliability-framing (score 1) is currently the sole lowest-score issue, so it is the front-runner unless something in state has changed since this task was written; (2) if there were a tie, upstream issues (those other issues depend_on) would outrank dependents -- note task-dependent-reliability-framing itself DEPENDS ON the other 4 issues (it's a downstream synthesis node), so if a tie ever put it against one of its dependencies, the dependency would win the tie-break, but no tie currently exists since its score (1) is strictly lowest; (3) apply the attempt penalty (config.yml scoring.tie_break_recent_attempt_penalty=1 per attempt within last 5 cycles) by checking each issue's attempts[] array in state/issues/graph.json against the current cycle number; (4) remaining ties broken by older created_cycle first. Compute the full ranking table fresh from the live state/assessments/scores.json and state/issues/graph.json files (do not just trust this summary -- re-derive it, since state may have shifted) and record it in the cycle log for auditability. Refresh rule: if current_cycle %% config.yml schedule.collect_refresh_every (7) == 0, write a T1 task (fresh evidence collection) targeting the selected issue instead of T3 -- check this arithmetic against the actual current cycle number at run time, do not assume. If the selected issue is task-dependent-reliability-framing and a T3 (investigate) task is warranted (not a T1 refresh cycle), the instructions should point the investigator at its 3 unresolved open_questions (taxonomy of CTI sub-tasks by reliability risk; whether a hybrid human-validated pipeline like LANCE/src-0003 would generalize to ATT&CK mapping or attribution; whether the task-dependence conclusion would survive independent replication of src-0003's single-study IoC result) and remind them the candidate_resolution's status is still 'proposed' and needs either independent evidence to move to 'supported' or explicit reasoning for why the synthesis itself counts as adequately grounded. If all issues eventually score 5, write a T2 scope-review task per the T5 prompt's fallback instructions instead.
